task: Unseen bacterial strain -> rank a fixed known-phage library for source-defined MLC positivity
development_status: New ranking analysis on an already inspected cohort; no independent confirmation or model promotion
candidate_rule: All 94 named library phages, fixed before evaluation; score every candidate, including pairs without labels; never filter by held-out positives
label_rule: Reconcile source MLC with the registered binary subset; missing MLC is unknown, not zero. Primary metrics require every panel label for a host.
tie_policy: Exact expectation over uniform within-score-tie permutations; random and constant global prevalence are identical expectations
denominators: Report complete-panel host coverage, all complete-panel hosts and eligible complete-panel hosts with >=1 observed positive; no-positive hosts have Hit/MRR=0 and undefined Recall
primary: Grouped-host test all-complete-host Hit@2: host_evo2_logistic minus phage_prevalence; all pairwise representation comparisons and phylogroups descriptive. No release promotion.
scenarios: leave each published Clermont phylogroup out, purging any touching near-clonal host components from train

estimator.rule: Refit the unchanged host model in each scenario; unique train hosts only for preprocessing; no model selection

not_run.GenoPHI: No aligned full-panel strain-held-out scores available; official 25x25 demo is a separate cohort
not_run.Omnii: No Omnii weights/scores; this is an analogous task definition, not numerical reproduction
not_run.Evo2: Protocol and cache/evaluation path only until a real 40B deployment lock and complete verified cache are supplied; no GPU-derived result is claimed.

limitations: Already inspected development cohort and a fixed source assay; not an independent release holdout.
Published near-clonal groups are reused from the hashed frozen manifest; raw genomes and core distances are not re-verified by this table-only runner.
Random strain splitting may share related host groups with fitting; overlaps are reported.

Clermont phylogroups are published metadata, not reconstructed clades or the Omnii 37-strain holdout. All observed groups are reported, including small panels; intervals condition on each chosen group and fixed library.
Missing-panel hosts are excluded as whole hosts and counted. No claim for unevaluable hosts or unmeasured candidates.
Named phages include exact sequence duplicates; library is fixed by source IDs, with no phenotype-based merging.
Scores are uncalibrated MLC positivity scores; Hit@K describes finding at least one source-positive individual phage, not cocktail efficacy or clinical benefit.
All contrasts are descriptive development intervals; no multiplicity-adjusted discovery claim or automatic retraining.

The published distance matrix was built jointly on the source collection: label-free but transductive. This diagnostic is not a deployable online distance estimator or independent prospective validation.
Neighbour transfer measures similarity-associated predictive signal; it does not establish why a phage works or fails.
The fixed k=5 is prespecified without a sweep; boundary weights define a fractional kernel, not an expectation of a nonlinear missing-label estimator.
Unknown overlap of source genomes with Evo2 pretraining; held-out hosts refer only to supervised fitting.
8192-dimensional embeddings have much greater capacity than 136 4-mer features, and fixed C does not equalize capacity or effective regularization.
Sampled windows may miss causal loci; embeddings do not establish a mechanistic susceptibility explanation.

neighbours.distance: Pinned source core-genome distance; no distance fitting or outcome-based selection
neighbours.tie_policy: Fractional boundary weights: all strictly nearer hosts get weight 1; equal-distance boundary hosts share remaining neighbour mass
neighbours.score: For each phage, (weighted observed positives + 1) / (weighted observed labels + 2); no observed neighbour labels -> train-only Beta(1,1) phage prevalence. Missing labels never replaced by zero. Select neighbours globally before consulting phage labels.

embedding.contigs: Canonicalize each IUPAC contig as min(forward,reverse-complement), sort lexicographically including duplicates. Do not concatenate or rotate circular genomes.
embedding.windows: Non-overlapping windows within each canonical contig, including short final windows. Flatten in contig/start order. Select min(32,N) indices floor(i*(N-1)/(m-1)), or index 0 if m=1.
embedding.ambiguity: Map non-ACGT IUPAC bases to N at the same position after canonicalization. Never delete bases.
embedding.strands: Forward and reverse complement of every selected window; no BOS, EOS, padding, species tag or context carried between windows.
embedding.pooling: Token mean per orientation in float32; average both orientations; host mean weighted by original window length, accumulated in float64 then stored float32. No layer selection, PCA, normalization or fine-tuning.
embedding.coverage: Systematic sampled-window representation, not full-genome or whole-context encoding; export selected bases and total assembly bases.
embedding.deployment_lock: Before even the pilot, bind local checkpoint SHA256, installed config SHA256 and software versions/revisions plus precision and hardware. Actual runtime hashes unavailable in this session; protocol alone is not a frozen deployed checkpoint.
embedding.pilot: First three lexicographically sorted cohort hosts; hardware/time/QC only, never examine pilot interaction outcomes. Same weights/layer/precision/windows for full run; changes require a versioned amendment before scoring.
embedding.source_note: Upstream demonstrates embeddings at blocks.28.mlp.l3 on 7B; using that module on 40B is a prespecified engineering choice, not a published optimal phage-host representation. Confirm module and output width during pilot; fail rather than substitute.
